content.text:
**Finding submitted: COMPLIANT (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

The document contains no exclusivity obligation binding the Issuer or Depositor. The engagement of Cellco as Servicer, Custodian and Marketing Agent is a non-exclusive appointment, and our side retains the ability to terminate and appoint a Successor Servicer. The three "exclusive" hits flagged by the planner are either a control right running in our favour (Cap Collateral Account) or a forum reference (nonexclusive jurisdiction) — neither is a restrictive covenant, and neither should be flagged against a clause that benefits our party.
